The '''Battle of Sullust''' was a battle fought between the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] and the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]]. Following the [[Second Battle of Endor]], a portion of the Alliance fleet including the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] arrived at [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] and was ambushed by Nagai ships. After a costly battle, the Nagai were forced to retreat.
